quote: A city that cannot house its nurses and teachers is not expensive. It is broken — and expensive is the word we use to avoid saying so.
author: Ada Merrick

quote: We did not fall out of love with reading. We fell out of the habit of being unreachable, and books were collateral damage.
author: Theo Brandt

quote: Adaptation is not surrender. Ask the crew hauling blankets up a glacier at dawn what refusing to quit actually looks like.
author: Lena Hartwig
